name: Teamworks Summer Camp – Seekonk
description_short: Weekly day camp at the Teamworks indoor sports facility in Seekonk, running 9am–3:30pm with extended day until 5pm. Offers a general camp (ages 4–14) with sports, games and arts & crafts, plus sport specialty weeks (ages 6–14) in basketball, flag football, soccer and baseball.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: FUN Summer Camps for Children Ages 4-14

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season (June 15–September 4, 2026), and it is already over as of 2026-10-13. No 2027 information is posted yet.
The page contradicts itself about how long the camp has been in Seekonk: it says '4th summer in Seekonk', 'excited to expand to Seekonk this summer', and 'great 3rd year'.
No camp prices are listed. The only figure is the $50-per-week deposit to save a spot.
A Teamworks Membership is required on top of camp registration.
Sport specialty camps are for ages 6–14, while the general TW Camp is for ages 4–14.
Teamworks runs camps at several locations. This listing covers the Seekonk, MA site only.
